purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, bounded request outcomes, scope limits, and safe-field policy for San Cristóbal, Táchira, Venezuela.
assessment: A local municipal cadastral custodian and procedure are evidenced by official ordinances, but no public parcel geometry, safe native parcel identity, schema/CRS, or anonymous parcel API was verified.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is based on the official municipal site's published División de Catastro ordinance/procedure evidence. This is not evidence that the registry is openly downloadable or citywide geometrically accessible.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official municipal website; links to municipal ordinances and a San Cristóbal Vensat application.
Official ordinance index listing the municipal-land ordinance and the 2023 cadastral ordinance.
Official 2021 municipal-land ordinance; identifies the División de Catastro, technical/legal cadastral areas, parcel measurements and municipal parcel procedures.
Official-domain copy of the same municipal-land ordinance; used as corroborating first-party evidence.
Public application shell; current Vite/React source was inspectable, but no anonymous parcel layer or safe geometry route was exposed.

viewerConfiguration.observedTechnology: Vite/React public app shell with a login route and Socket.IO client configuration. Source disclosed API base https://sancristobal.vensat.io:8443 and /socket.io, but not a public cadastral layer endpoint.
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: No parcel schema or CRS was verified.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official municipal San Cristóbal sources and the linked public application.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Municipal cadastral procedure/custodian evidenced; no open parcel layer or geometry verified.

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained; no qualifying safe anonymous parcel response was verified.

runtimeAssessment.reason: A local registry/procedure is evidenced, but no independent anonymous ID-plus-geometry response or qualified adapter source was found.

uncertainty: A restricted, offline, or authenticated municipal cadastral system may exist. Search non-result, login wall, 404 guesses, and absence of geometry do not prove citywide absence. Exact WUP point retained: [7.76727602889449, -72.2246713867036].
